notes.title: November 25 version 2.3.1 update
notes.notes:
Dear Lords :
We have updated version 2.3.1 today (November 25), the followings are the updated description.

The updated description is organized as follows :
[Fix abnormal problems]

1. Fix the abnormality that some historical events cannot be operated on when they end.

notes.title: September 28 version 2.3.0 update（Lastupdate 2022/09/28 15:00）
notes.notes:
Dear players :
We have updated version 2.3.0 today (September28), the following is the updated description.

Updates are organized as follows
[New Features]
1. Add the function of the history event list.
　a. You can check the trigger conditions and results of historical events.
　b. You can check the current progress of historical event triggering and condition completion.

"Adjustments and optimization"
2. Fix the abnormality of the judgment result of auto-battle and optimize the calculation formula.
3. Fix some art data misplacing problems.
4. Fix some UI messages and skill description text abnormalities.

notes.title: April 7 version 2.2.0 update （Lastupdate 2022/04/07 14:00）
notes.notes:
Dear players :
We have updated version 2.2.0 today (April 7), the following is the updated description.

Updates are organized as follows
[New features] 
1. English language support added.
2. New automatic appointment of official positions of the condition filter function.

[Problem fixed, adjustment and optimization]
3. The sorting of the treasury item list has been fixed.
4. Currency information added in the treasury sale interface.
5. Information of generals' attributes in the equipment configuration added.
6. Display of the basic weapon attributes has been fixed.
7. The issue of the exile of a general in the wild has been fixed.
8. Adjusted the rules for the appearance of famous generals' special weapons.
9. Lock prompt in RTS mode added.
10. Mouse sensing range of the UI Slider component has been fixed.
11. Part of the UI text layout has been fixed.
12. Part of the display of some art words has been fixed.
13. Part of the error of some warriors' names and numbers has been fixed.
